caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a human figure, rendered to resemble a sculpture made from a single block of wood. The bust includes the head, neck, and upper chest and shoulders, with a flat base at the bottom. The wood grain texture is meticulously shown throughout, with swirling, wavy, and linear patterns in varying shades of brown, representing natural wood coloring. The facial features such as eyes, ear, nose, and lips are simplified but recognizable, with lines marking the contours and details. The bust appears to be missing detail where the nose meets the face, suggesting either stylization or damage. The material’s wood grain is emphasized, running both horizontally and vertically with darker and lighter brown contrasts, highlighting different planes and sections of the bust. The background is a solid, pale beige color with no additional objects or details.
title: Primitive Bust
